## Variables

### AgentHead

```ts
const AgentHead: NamedExoticComponent<{
  timeMs?: number;
  activity?: AgentHeadActivity;
  avatar: {
    v: 1;
    character: "mushroom" | "cat" | "burger";
    appearance: z.ZodRecord<
      z.ZodString,
      z.ZodUnion<readonly [z.ZodString, z.ZodNumber, z.ZodBoolean]>
    >;
    expression: string;
    renderStyle:
      | "plain"
      | "pencil"
      | "manga"
      | "riso"
      | "halftone"
      | "blueprint"
      | "crt"
      | "watercolor";
  };
  className?: string;
  name: string;
  size?: number;
}>;
```

An Agent's head at avatar size, drawn from the Agent's own avatar (a property of
the Agent record, never of a conversation). The letter shows until a frame is
ready. The live canvas stays mounted and is paused unless `thinking` or
`speaking`, so an idle head shows its real look without animating.

---

### ShiitakeAvatar

```ts
const ShiitakeAvatar: NamedExoticComponent<{
  avatar?: {
    v: 1;
    character: "mushroom" | "cat" | "burger";
    appearance: z.ZodRecord<
      z.ZodString,
      z.ZodUnion<readonly [z.ZodString, z.ZodNumber, z.ZodBoolean]>
    >;
    expression: string;
    renderStyle:
      | "plain"
      | "pencil"
      | "manga"
      | "riso"
      | "halftone"
      | "blueprint"
      | "crt"
      | "watercolor";
  } | null;
  className?: string;
  service?: SpriteService;
  state: AvatarState;
}>;
```

A sprite head drawn in the live activity and expression it is given. With an
`avatar` it draws that look (a member's own, in their settings); with none it is
Shiitake, the product mascot, in the character's own defaults. Conversations
have no avatar: an Agent's head is `AgentHead`, drawn from the Agent record.

### visibleToolCalls()

```ts
function visibleToolCalls(
  group,
  open,
): readonly Readonly<{
  id: string;
  kind: ParakeetToolKind;
  name: string;
  verb: string;
  activeVerb: string;
  label: string;
  paths: readonly string[];
  status: "error" | "unknown" | "running" | "completed";
  durationMs?: number;
  exitCode?: number;
  error?: string;
  sections: readonly ParakeetToolCallSection[];
}>[];
```

Even a folded group shows recent calls, rather than hiding all tool work.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                              |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `group`   | [`ParakeetToolGroupItem`](#parakeettoolgroupitem) |
| `open`    | `boolean`                                         |

#### Returns

readonly `Readonly`\<\{ `id`: `string`; `kind`:
[`ParakeetToolKind`](#parakeettoolkind); `name`: `string`; `verb`: `string`;
`activeVerb`: `string`; `label`: `string`; `paths`: readonly `string`[];
`status`: `"error"` \| `"unknown"` \| `"running"` \| `"completed"`;
`durationMs?`: `number`; `exitCode?`: `number`; `error?`: `string`; `sections`:
readonly [`ParakeetToolCallSection`](#parakeettoolcallsection)[]; \}\>[]
